note: Primarily a vulnerability-management dashboard that ingests and displays third-party scanner output; its license 'management' is thin reporting rather than actual license detection/collection or cross-source reconciliation, so it only has superficial overlap with RQ2/RQ3.

Narrow personal-privacy utility for auditing and bulk-deleting your own Reddit comment history via the Reddit API; it is not a general dataset-curation tool for identifying or removing problematic data from training corpora.

It statistically estimates differential-privacy epsilon from the confusion matrix of a membership-inference attack; this is privacy-budget accounting/auditing, not identification/removal of problematic data, license handling, or eval-time contamination detection, so it does not fit any of RQ1-6.
